QuestInfo.name: Tomorrow's Gift Box
QuestInfo.0: #b#p9010000##k has something to say. Why don't you visit?
QuestInfo.1: Defeating Maple World monsters while #b#p9010000##k prepares Tomorrow's Gift Box seems like a productive way to pass the time. Why not?
QuestInfo.2: #b#p9010000##k happily gave you #b#t2430638##k, but it can't be opened until tomorrow. But with patience comes rewards. You can exchange it for a better box tomorrow. It's nice to have something to look forward to.
